title: fw-wan VRFs & routing
description: Routing tables, BGP sessions and interfaces per VRF. Router picker (default fw-wan; the VyOS leaves and DHCP VMs work too).

panels.title: BGP sessions
panels.description: BGP sessions reported by frr_exporter (underlay IPv6 unicast, EVPN to the spines, external peerings). A router whose exporter is down drops out of the total.

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Zebra RIB routes over all VRFs.

panels.title: VRFs
panels.description: VRFs with a routing table (default not counted).

panels.title: Route changes in range
panels.description: Times a VRF's route count changed in the selected time range (scrape resolution).

panels.title: RIB not in FIB
panels.description: Zebra routes that aren't installed in the kernel (inactive or rejected).

panels.title: Routing tables
panels.description: Per VRF: zebra RIB and kernel FIB routes per address family, route count changes in range, IPv4 and IPv6 unicast BGP RIB entries (the leaves' IPv6 underlay and EVPN are in the default VRF; EVPN is on the FRR / EVPN fabric dashboard) and established BGP sessions.

panels.title: Route changes
panels.description: Route count changes per interval and VRF (a flapping route shows as a column of bars).

panels.title: RIB routes not in the FIB

targets.expr: sum by (vrf) (frr_route_total{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"}) - sum by (vrf) (frr_route_total_fib{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"}) > 0

defaults.noValue: All RIB routes are in the FIB

panels.title: BGP peers
panels.description: One row per session (VRF, address family, peer). Interface peers (eth1.1000/eth2.1000 on fw-wan) are BGP unnumbered; the hostname comes from the peer's BGP hostname capability.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job, role, host) (frr_bgp_peer_state{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"})
max without (instance, job, role, host) (frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"})
max without (instance, job, role, host) (frr_bgp_peer_prefixes_received_count_total{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"})
max without (instance, job, role, host) (frr_bgp_peer_prefixes_advertised_count_total{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"})
max without (instance, job, role, host) (rate(frr_bgp_peer_message_received_total{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"}[5m]) + rate(frr_bgp_peer_message_sent_total{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"}[5m]))
max without (instance, job, role, host) (resets(frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"}[$__range]))

defaults.noValue: No BGP sessions on this router

targets.expr: max without (instance, job, role, local_as, peer_as, peer_hostname, peer_desc, peer_type) (frr_bgp_peer_state{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"})

defaults.noValue: No BGP sessions on this router

panels.title: BGP messages
panels.description: Messages per second (updates and keepalives), rx + tx.

defaults.noValue: No BGP sessions on this router

panels.title: Traffic per VRF
panels.description: Counters of the VRF devices: traffic received on or sent from the VRF's interfaces (received above the axis, sent below).

targets.expr: rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{host="$host"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8 and on (host, device) label_replace(group by (host, vrf) (frr_route_total{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"}), "device", "$1", "vrf", "(.+)")

rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{host="$host"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8 and on (host, device) label_replace(group by (host, vrf) (frr_route_total{host="$host", vrf=~"$vrf"}), "device", "$1", "vrf", "(.+)")

panels.title: Interface traffic (in + out)
